system.description: 6 IP: one creature permanently gains +10 maximum HP or +10 maximum MP, or +5 of each, the target's choice — once per creature ever. Restored 5 Aug under the derived-stat rule: the gain attaches to the Guise the recipient is wearing when dosed, not to the body. Dose the coat, not the man — hand that Guise on and the +10 goes with it, while an Innate-only character takes it into the frame they can never remove. "Once per creature" reads once per Guise, once per Innate frame.
